get_lr_at_epoch: get the learning rate for a given epoch with warmup support using an LRSchedulerConf
lr_func_cosine: compute the cosine annealing learning rate for a given epoch and scheduler config
lr_func_steps_with_relative_lrs: compute the step-based learning rate using relative LR multipliers for a given epoch
get_step_index: retrieve the LR step index for a given epoch based on configured step boundaries
set_lr: set the learning rate on all parameter groups of a PyTorch optimizer
